main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of next 2-bar excess return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= 2 to confirm (t <= -2 to reject) on at least 5000 independent cases

supporting_check.name: top minus bottom |forecast| quintile mean of sign(forecast) x excess 2-bar return, Welch t >= 2

decided_by: The slope is positive with t >= 2 on at least 5000 independent cases, and the supporting check passes.
reading: Each coin's mean 2-bar return is taken over its non-overlapping grid in all windows; the regression is OLS with an intercept on all grid bars, zero forecasts included; the quintiles are pooled over coins (|f| >= 80th percentile and |f| <= 20th percentile, ties included); the check passes when top minus bottom is positive with Welch t >= 2.
